what: Isaac owns live physics and streams to Unreal over LiveKit; a virtual block in Isaac holds both the sim and real arms
why: Brian confirmed how Isaac and Unreal split the work during the demo, so the stream and interlock can be built against one plan.
details: Physics-based rehearsal, no accuracy claims; draw the human from the same Isaac frame; one portal-makermods message format; Unreal physics off for Isaac-owned objects; freeze the layout before rehearsals; hold the last pose with a sim-offline tag on drops.
